content.value_statement: Teams need brand concepts that look coherent before they invest in a full identity system. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create polished brand-kit boards with logos, palettes, mockups, and visual rules.
actual_capabilities: Creates one-image brand-kit overview boards using 3x3, 2x3, 2x2, 1x3, 4x2, or custom layouts.
Defines brand strategy inputs such as audience, product function, emotional promise, and symbolic metaphor.
Guides logo concepting through monograms, product actions, metaphor fusion, negative space, and construction geometry.
Specifies panels for logo cover, construction, digital application, tagline, color system, typography, mockups, and system details.
Provides visual modes for developer tools, security, compliance, luxury, communication, cultural, nature, and product brands.
Uses reference images for rhythm and quality while avoiding copied marks, names, slogans, compositions, or assets.
limitations: It creates visual direction prompts and images, not production-ready vector logo files.
Generated typography and small text may need manual correction before client presentation.
It cannot verify trademark availability or legal distinctiveness of a logo concept.
It depends on clear user strategy details for the strongest results.

use_cases.title: Explore a New Identity
use_cases.description: Generate an early brand direction with a logo concept, palette, typography, mockups, and image style before hiring a full design team.

use_cases.title: Create Client Concept Boards
use_cases.description: Turn a strategy brief into a polished presentation board that shows identity logic, application examples, and visual atmosphere.

use_cases.title: Align Launch Visuals
use_cases.description: Create a shared visual direction for campaign pages, product surfaces, social assets, and internal launch reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Brand Kit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete board.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a premium brand-kit overview image for [brand]. The product is [category] for [audience]. Use a 3x3 layout with a logo cover, color system, typography, mockup, image direction, and system detail.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Logo Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on a mark.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a brand-kit board for [brand] using the core metaphor [metaphor]. Develop a simple logo concept that combines [initial or symbol] with [product action]. Show construction logic, applications, palette, and typography.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Reference Mood
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using references without copying.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my references only for quality, rhythm, spacing, and visual density. Create a premium brand-kit image for [brand] with [visual mode], [palette], and [audience]. Do not copy any exact logo, slogan, asset, or composition.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Identity Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with strategy and layout control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete brand-kit overview for [brand]. Strategy: category [category], audience [audience], personality [traits], emotional promise [promise], cultural position [position], core metaphor [metaphor], and avoided associations [avoid]. Use a [layout] grid with logo construction, product surface, campaign image, color system, typography, physical application, and system detail.

output_examples.input: Create a brand kit for an AI meeting assistant for enterprise teams.
output_examples.output: A polished identity board with a clear signal-based logo, calm enterprise palette, app-header mockup, typography sample, tagline panel, and system details for notes and summaries.

output_examples.input: Create a security brand kit with a dark threat-intelligence mood.
output_examples.output: A cinematic board with a protected-core symbol, dark interface panels, restrained warning accents, badge applications, construction geometry, and a concise trust-focused tagline.

output_examples.input: Create a light editorial identity for a compliance platform.
output_examples.output: A clean guidelines-style board with seal logic, document-inspired mockups, quiet typography, neutral palette cards, and a professional image direction for regulated buyers.

best_practices: Provide the category, audience, personality, and core metaphor before asking for visuals.
Ask for a specific layout and visual mode when the presentation format matters.
Review generated marks for originality, readability, and legal suitability before use.
anti_patterns: Do not request a copied version of a known logo or campaign.
Do not expect production-ready typography or vector artwork from a single generated board.
Do not overload the board with many slogans, palettes, and unrelated symbols.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates premium brand-kit overview images with logo concepts, layout structure, palettes, typography, mockups, and visual-system details.

faq.question: Can it create a final production logo?
faq.answer: No. It creates strong visual concepts, but a designer should refine final vector artwork and usage rules.

faq.question: Does it support different brand categories?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes modes for developer tools, security, compliance, luxury, communication, culture, nature, and product brands.

faq.question: Can I use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses references for rhythm, quality, spacing, and density while avoiding exact copied content.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the brand name, category, audience, personality, product function, desired mood, and any symbols to include or avoid.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
